correctness.rationale: Complete 65536-mask double enumeration and exhaustive acyclic matching on 45706 faces (329552 cover incidences) give a Morse CW model with only one 0-, ten 7- and one 9-cell; all cellular boundaries vanish by dimension, proving the integral homology. An explicit 448-simplex closed oriented nine-cycle and exact integer reduction under all 384 signed graph automorphisms prove the H9 character. Fixed-simplex signed Lefschetz summation gives the H7 character; rational transfer gives quotient invariants. Published suspension equivalence plus 16-vertex Alexander duality gives the Q5 consequence; no homotopy wedge is claimed.

value.rationale: The four-dimensional hypercube is a canonical vertex-transitive cubical graph, and its dominance complex is a natural object in published topology. Exact torsion-free integral homology in two nonadjacent dimensions, the full B4 symmetry character, and the two-dimensional rational quotient invariant provide structural information beyond a face-vector computation; established Alexander duality additionally yields the complete integral ordinary independence homology of the next cube Q5. The precise problem is motivated, not an arbitrary table slice.
